reviews.mechanism_and_interactions: The completed reader tied 43 generated C bodies to 11 native claims and 12 installed snapshot/API selections. It found extraction limits that matter to interpretation: electric partial C omits the clamp, HeatBuffer long casts appear as floating loads/stores, and HeatEnergySource’s conditional extraction void signature misses boolean w0, so instruction evidence takes precedence. For spoilage-related helpers, canGiveProducts forwards the ingredient spoil scalar unchanged; canGiveItemProduct showed no product-offset read/addition, while giveProducts adds product+0x34. This helper asymmetry is not itself a runtime bug claim.
